title: SSP2-EU21-NPi2025
description: SSP2-EU21-NPi2025: This National Policies Implemented (NPi) scenario follows the Shared Socioeconomic Pathways 2 called Middle of the Road. The NPi reflects currently implemented policies, while fulfilling near-term feasibility and long-term plausibility assessments. Emissions trajectories are aligned with bottom-up studies on the effect of currently implemented policies. Carbon prices are constant in the mid- and long-term.

title: SSP2-EU21-PkBudg1000
c_regi_earlyreti_rate: EUR_regi 0.08, USA_regi 0.07, CHA_regi 0.07, CAZ_regi 0.07,  JPN_regi 0.07, GLO 0.06
description: SSP2-EU21-PkBudg1050: This climate policy scenario follows the SSP2. The stylized climate policy scenario assumes a peak budget of 1050 Gt CO2 on total CO2 emissions from 2015 to 2100. This is a well below 2C scenario at median climate sensitivity but returns to values below 2C in at least 67 % of scenarios during the whole century.

title: SSP2-EU21-PkBudg750
c_regi_earlyreti_rate: EUR_regi 0.08, USA_regi 0.07, CHA_regi 0.07, CAZ_regi 0.07,  JPN_regi 0.07, GLO 0.06
description: SSP2-EU21-PkBudg750: This climate policy scenario follows the SSP2. The stylized climate policy scenario assumes a peak budget of 750 Gt CO2 on total CO2 emissions from 2015 to 2100. This is a 1.5C scenario, peak warming is allowed to be at or slightly above 1.5C at median climate sensitivity but returns to values below 1.5C in at least 67 % of scenarios by the end of the century.

title: SSP2-NPi2025-PFMbase
description: SSP2-NPi2025-PFMbase: unchanged current-policies baseline, included so the coupled pair has its reference price path (P_ref) in the same run set.

title: SSP2-NPi2025-PFMratio
description: NPi twin of the ratio mechanism (bind mode 1). Runs the coupling on the CURRENT-POLICIES pathway, so an effect seen only in the ambitious runs can be attributed to the coupling rather than to what the mechanism does to any price path.

title: SSP2-NPi2025-PFMlevel
description: NPi twin of the absolute-cap mechanism (bind mode 2). Same role as -PFMratio: separates the coupling effect from the mechanism effect. Needs path_gdx_ref for P_ref.

title: SSP2-NPi2025-PFMmildProg
description: NPi twin of mild progression (bind mode 3). The price is generated from the political dynamics seeded on the NPi price, which is where mode M is most directly interpretable.

title: SSP2-PkBudg1000-PFMref
c_regi_earlyreti_rate: EUR_regi 0.08, USA_regi 0.07, CHA_regi 0.07, CAZ_regi 0.07,  JPN_regi 0.07, GLO 0.06
description: SSP2-PkBudg1000-PFMref: reference twin of SSP2-PkBudg1000-PFMfeas using the standard ScenarioMIP2050 differentiation, identical in every other respect, so the political-feasibility effect is read as a difference against an otherwise identical run.

title: SSP2-PkBudg1000-PFMratio
c_regi_earlyreti_rate: EUR_regi 0.08, USA_regi 0.07, CHA_regi 0.07, CAZ_regi 0.07,  JPN_regi 0.07, GLO 0.06
description: Run 1 (bind mode R). phi scales the global anchor: politics redistributes WHERE abatement happens and the 1000 Gt budget is always met. Also the robustness check on the level runs - if the story only appears under mode L, that must be reported.

title: SSP2-PkBudg1000-PFMlevelB
c_regi_earlyreti_rate: EUR_regi 0.08, USA_regi 0.07, CHA_regi 0.07, CAZ_regi 0.07,  JPN_regi 0.07, GLO 0.06
description: Run 2 (bind mode L, conflict rule B). phi caps the ABSOLUTE price at phi*P_feasible and the budget forcing is OFF (cm_iterative_target_adj=0), so emissions land where politics allows. Headline candidate: political feasibility costs X Gt CO2.

title: SSP2-PkBudg1000-PFMlevelC
c_regi_earlyreti_rate: EUR_regi 0.08, USA_regi 0.07, CHA_regi 0.07, CAZ_regi 0.07,  JPN_regi 0.07, GLO 0.06
description: Run 3 (bind mode L, conflict rule C). Absolute cap AND the budget held, so the run reports where the cost-optimal price must exceed the political bound. Headline candidate: meeting 1000 Gt requires region R to sustain N x its politically feasible price. May be infeasible by design - that is the finding.

title: SSP2-PkBudg1000-PFMgate
c_regi_earlyreti_rate: EUR_regi 0.08, USA_regi 0.07, CHA_regi 0.07, CAZ_regi 0.07,  JPN_regi 0.07, GLO 0.06
description: INTERFACE CORRECTNESS GATE - run FIRST, before any science run, and compare against SSP2-PkBudg1000-PFMgateRef (NOT PFMref). cm_pfmTheta = 0 forces every phi to 1, so the coupled run must reproduce the UNIFORM-price twin exactly  any difference is an interface bug, not a finding. It exercises the whole round trip - the Rscript call, the gdx write, Execute_Loadpoint, the freshness stamp, the convergence test and the Nash criterion - with the smallest possible surface area.

title: SSP2-PkBudg1000-PFMgateRef
c_regi_earlyreti_rate: EUR_regi 0.08, USA_regi 0.07, CHA_regi 0.07, CAZ_regi 0.07,  JPN_regi 0.07, GLO 0.06
description: GATE TWIN - the uncoupled comparison PFMgate must reproduce. cm_taxCO2_regiDiff = 0 (none) gives a UNIFORM global price, which is precisely what regiDiff = 11 with cm_pfmTheta = 0 (phi = 1 everywhere) produces. The previous twin was PFMref, which uses regiDiff = 6 (ScenarioMIP2050 convergence) - a DIFFERENT differentiation scheme, so the gate could never match it and its $90/tCO2 disagreement in 2030 said nothing about the interface. Identical to PFMgate in every other setting.

title: SSP2-PkBudg1000-PFMmildProg
c_regi_earlyreti_rate: EUR_regi 0.08, USA_regi 0.07, CHA_regi 0.07, CAZ_regi 0.07,  JPN_regi 0.07, GLO 0.06
description: Mode M (mild progression, Elmar variant). The price is GENERATED by the political dynamics - P(t+1) = P(t)(1 + lambda (S*-S)/S) seeded with the observed current-policy price - rather than constraining the cost-optimal path. No budget, so it cannot be infeasible: whatever emissions follow are the result. Needs path_gdx_ref for the seed. Check cappedShare in the log before quoting the path.

title: SSP2-PFMtest1-ratio
description: FAST INTERFACE TEST 1 (~25 min, not a science run). Fires the coupling at Nash iteration 2 instead of 15 and stops at 3, so the whole round trip is observed in minutes rather than hours. TWO calls are the point: call 1 reports delta as first-call, call 2 must either converge or show a real delta - the previous convergence test could never fire at delta = 0 and looped forever. CHECK IN THE LOG: 'startYear: 2030' in pfm-coupling-runtime.yml -- 'tier year derived from cm_startyear 2030 -> 2035' -- phi NOT equal between calls, or CONVERGED -- no *** Status: Execution error(s).

title: SSP2-PFMtest2-level
description: FAST INTERFACE TEST 2 (~40 min, not a science run). Same early-firing trick for bind mode 2, which loads the rank-2 price bound and applies the absolute cap - the path that carries the paper's headline. Three calls, so a converged loop must SKIP the third R call: if a third 'reading REMIND state' appears after CONVERGED, the freeze is not working. CHECK ALSO: the cap must not be applied before the first call - the log should say 'no price bound yet - running on the anchor' at iteration 1.
